snippet.title: Babushka - Developer Deep Dive | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Lead Game Designer Katharina Ziolkowski from Cozy Raven Interactive shares a deeper look at Babushka and reveals more about its world, gameplay and Slavic inspirations.

Babushka is a narrative 2D farming roguelite set in a mystical Slavic forest. Step into the role of Vesna, a quest-completing grandma living in a remote community of babushkas far away from civilization.

Farm for resources and survival during the day before venturing into the tainted forest at night, where mutated creatures and malicious forest spirits await in turn-based combat. Progress through Vesna's story and encounter mysterious beings inspired by Slavic folklore, including Domovoi, Mavka and Leshy.

Wishlist Babushka now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3495130/Babushka/
